scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Moses is imagined listening reverently as the LORD speaks. God remains unseen. The wilderness camp, clothing, expression, and morning light are illustrative choices; this verse does not specify them or give the message that follows. The scene conveys attentive reception without inventing the words spoken.
